stages.title: SHADOW MOSES · CANYON
reviewNotes: Recessed northern warhead storage gate, grey segmented facade, right service cylinders and enclosed snowy rock basin match the inspected original map landmarks.
No tank or characters baked into the scenery; separate existing M1 rig can be linked by Root.
Lateral camera and clear snow fighting plane are CQC adaptations. Exact original PS1 pixel/color fidelity is not certified.

placement.foregroundGroundingNotes: Choose the clear lower snow lane; do not translate the boss rig with player movement. Camera should remain fixed for the giant-boss encounter.

stages.title: SHADOW MOSES · COMMUNICATIONS TOWER B
reviewNotes: The faceted water-tank cover, rectangular left access hut, open pale guardrails and patterned metal-grate floor match the inspected MGS1 roof landmarks.
No Tower A satellite dish, helicopter, character, HUD or guide annotation is baked in.
The lateral clear combat lane, warm/cold grading and cover placement are adaptations. Cover is scenery, not a newly implemented collision system.

placement.foregroundGroundingNotes: Use the broad clear lower rooftop lane. The water tank and hut must remain behind the feet of fighters. Keep the giant-boss camera fixed rather than tracking the player.

targetExistingEncounter.qualification: Exact current encounter and machine IDs confirmed independently by p54_machine_audit; Root selects the final stage ID and edits the runtime mapping.

stages.title: R-00 · AFRICAN AVENUE
reviewNotes: The damaged beige modern tower, first RAY street, warm dusty overcast daylight, civic facades, awnings, street trees, palms and distant turbine match identified R00 landmarks.
No RAY, Raiden, robot limb, HUD, subtitles or watermark is baked in. This is not the R01 Abkhazia location or the later R00 train.
Flattened lateral roadway, wider clear fighting lane and facade spacing are CQC adaptations. No pixel-perfect or native renderer/platform certification is claimed.

placement.foregroundGroundingNotes: The lower asphalt lane is clear and level. The existing RAY rig should remain world-anchored; the giant-boss camera must not track the approaching player.

targetExistingEncounter.qualification: Exact current encounter and machine IDs confirmed independently by p54_machine_audit; Root selects the final stage ID and edits the runtime mapping.

canyonPreservation: Imagegen returned only a data URL during environment outage. Exact Base64 decoded once through noncanonical no-echo PTY stdin after recovery; PNG signature/decode/dimensions and hashes validated, no pixel edit. Earlier large MCP blob upload was interrupted without a receipt; Root watcher handles source commit.
runtimeAdmission: Pending Root integration, fixed giant-boss camera, stage mapping, and browser QA.
limits: These three opaque backgrounds are new authored scenery, not lossless recovery of old P53 files.
One flat background per encounter is provided. No separate foreground rig or full animated environment is claimed here.
Known game landmarks and edition boundaries are respected; lateral geometry and hidden surfaces remain adaptations.
referencePublication: Only selected physically viewed screenshots/maps as appropriate; no whole books, videos or transport HTML.
